【原视频简介】
Claude Fable 5.1 is Anthropic's new frontier model, with cache reads cut by 75% and a claimed 25 to 45% cost reduction on agentic work. We break down why that discount only applies to API usage, why Artificial Analysis found Fable 5.1 on max effort more expensive per task than Fable 5, and which effort level actually saves you money.
